description: Every account in an industry (or a custom company set): per-company rollup (page fit + people median over the 5 most active fitted people (peopleCounted), preliminary = "Few posts" under 40 team posts, solo = "1 account" when one fitted account carries the company), population vs the research baseline, and category lift with the author effect removed (which post types beat each author's own typical post). Public callers get bands and pooled lifts, the same as Discover. Use for "what works in fintech" or "where does X sit in its market".

companyIds.description: Custom company set (e.g. a customer + its competitors). Workspace keys: omit (with no industry) = own company + current competitors from the dashboard.

industry.description: Industry label, e.g. "Sales & Marketing Tech". Omit with companyIds for a custom set; omit both = the live dashboard set for workspace keys, the whole catalog for operators.

workspaceId.description: Internal callers only: default the set from this workspace.
